# AAPL fiscal 2024 Q3: bounded growth and margin

At latest-mode cutoff 2024-08-02T23:59:59+00:00, [original Q3 filing](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000081/aapl-20240629.htm) statements of operations, three-month columns, report revenue USD 85,777m versus 81,797m and gross profit 39,678m versus 36,413m. Dollar recomputation gives revenue growth 4.865704121178%, margin 46.257155181459% versus 44.516302553883%, an increase of 1.740852627576 percentage points. Sales less costs and category totals independently reconcile (calculations.json).

MD&A category changes in USD millions: iPhone -373, Mac +169, iPad +1,371, Wearables/Home/Accessories -187, Services +3,000; sum +3,980. Greater China decreased 1,030m. Services and iPad outweigh declining categories; this is not broad-based product strength. Management attributes Services margin expansion to mix. Causality and durability are not independently isolated. Product margin is approximately flat, a counterexample to extrapolating consolidated improvement into universal pricing power. Corrected source values or period definitions would invalidate the arithmetic.

Cross-quarter interpretation uses the preserved Q2 run03-derived baseline: Q2 revenue growth -4.305327090978% and margin expansion 2.316401771522pp; Q3 returns to year-over-year growth with smaller year-over-year margin expansion. This is a comparison of separate year-over-year rates, not seasonally adjusted sequential growth or a forecast. Q2 output/check/source/method identities agree; no Q2 bytes were rewritten. Its full-scope wording remains historical context, not this root's requirements.

The [original filing](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000081/aapl-20240629.htm) rendered DEI prefix declares fiscal 2024/Q3 and issuer 0000320193; cover identifies Apple Inc., AAPL, Form 10-Q and June 29, 2024 endpoint. Its Q3 2024 footer corroborates the quarter. The three-month statement comparison ends July 1, 2023; nine-month columns are separate. Retained start 2024-03-31 agrees with the page's rendered duration context. Identity comes from declarations and labels, not filename, calendar month, quote date or local file time.

[Q3 SEC index](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000081/0000320193-24-000081-index.html) binds accession 0000320193-24-000081, Form 10-Q, period 2024-06-29 and official filing 2024-08-02. Acceptance occurred on the preceding evenings; acceptance/signature times do not replace the official filing dates for this cutoff. Both original publication dates are eligible at 2024-08-02T23:59:59+00:00; intraday tradability is not established.

The Q3 transformed pack and metadata agree on fiscal identity, accession, period and raw digest 73c449ed301b494d1e217c21f2572fe80321d968d20388917292bc1cd95f6d27. No such conflict was observed in the selected passages. source-check.json distinguishes actual successful page checks from an unattempted acquisition CLI.
